The pavilion's name, Khuê Văn Các, borrows the image of the Khuê constellation, the brightest star in ancient astronomy, symbolizing literature and wisdom. Khuê Văn Các was erected by Tổng trấn Nguyễn Văn Thành under Emperor Gia Long of the Nguyen dynasty, a testament to the emperor's vision for a nation built on the pillars of Confucian learning and reverence for education.
